spans.s: ILLUDE: विप्रलभेते (लभ्, c. 1.): v. To deceive.

ILLUME, ILLUMINE:
(1) द्योतयति, उत्-, (c. of
द्युत्);
(2) भासयति (c. of भास्): v. To
light (III).

ILLUMINATE:
I To illumine: q.v.
II To
adorn with lights: दीर्पैः उद्भासयति (c. of
mas).
III of manuscripts: रञ्जयति (c. of
रञ्ज्).

ILLUMINATION:
I The act:
(1) द्योतनम्, प्र-;
(2) उद्भासनम्;
(3) दीपनम्।
II Festive decora-
-tion: दीपालिः (the i. festival).
III Decoration
of manuscripts: पत्रञ्जनम्।
IV Brightness,
splendour: q.v.

ILLUSION: माया,
is this an i. or is it delusion of
my mind:
माया स्विदेषा मतिविम्रमो वा, Ki. xvi. 18.

ILLUSIVE, ILLUSORY:
(1) मिथ्या in comp.: v.
False;
(2) असारः (रा, रं) (= unsubstantial).
Ph.:
i. show:
माया,
i. clouds:
मायामेघमाला, K.

ILLUSTRATE:
(1) स्फुटीकरोति;
(2) उदाहरति (हृ,
c. 1.): v. To exemplify.

ILLUSTRATION:
I The act.: expr. by verb:
v. Also elucidation, explanation.
II
Example: q.v.: उदाहरणम्, here in the first i.:
अत्राद्योदाहरणे,, KUV.;
i. s in order:
क्रमेणोदाहरणम्,
Kav.

ILLUSTRATIVE: expr. by verb or subs.,
it is i.
of this:
तदेतत् स्फुटीकरोति
or
तस्योदाहरणमेतत्।

ILLUSTRIOUS:
(1) महायशस् (mfn.); पुण्यश्लोकः
(का, कं); v. Famous, renowned, celebra-
-ted.
